title: Make a quiet moment for reading
caption: A calm reading spot makes the small daily promise on this page easier to keep. Watch the slow page turns, then try five attentive minutes yourself.

title: Put an idea into your own words
caption: This page suggests pausing to reflect on one idea. A reader taking notes shows how to turn a question into a short written response, rather than rushing through the text.

title: Make room on your reading shelf
caption: Explore the variety of books on these library shelves. Like the collections on this page, a shelf can hold familiar favorites alongside something you have never tried.

title: Let a book start a conversation
caption: The final page invites you to carry an idea into everyday life. This group reading together illustrates sharing a response with friends and listening to another perspective.
